name: Complex layered structure without commercial rationale
description: Multiple tiers of entities, trusts or foundations, often across secrecy or low-transparency jurisdictions, with no evident business or tax reason.
fp: Legitimate groups, estate planning and fund structures can be complex; request an explanation and structure chart.
